screen.title: Cloud
screen.lead: Throwaway instances in your own account, billed to you, stopped automatically.
screen.overOne: {name} is over its monthly budget. New labs there are blocked until you raise the budget or next month.
screen.overMany: {count} accounts are over their monthly budget. New labs there are blocked until you raise the budget or next month.
screen.billedOnly: billed only while a lab runs

firstRun.title: Run labs in your own cloud account
firstRun.body: One throwaway instance per lab, destroyed when you stop it. Runs on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

connect.title: Connect an account
connect.body: Access keys or your AWS CLI credentials, and a region.

pick.title: Pick it on a lab
pick.body: Terraform creates one instance, reachable over SSH from your IP.

stop.title: Attack, then Stop
stop.body: Stop destroys the instance, so billing stops with it.
